headline: Weathered Expanse Rages; Stlican Shelf Lulls
war_summary: Since the last edition the Weathered Expanse has taken the lead in the war's ownership ledger, logging six base-ownership events in two hours and sixty-five in the last day. The Stlican Shelf, which boiled over with ten such events in a two-hour span at last report, has since grown still in the latest two-hour ledger, though it still shows eleven events in six hours. Stonecradle and Viper Pit each logged three events in the latest two hours and eight in six. Farranac Coast likewise added three in two hours and six in six, while Linn Mercy — quiet in the earlier report — stirred with three events in the latest two-hour window. Callahan's Passage, still costly in blood, has not seen a base-ownership event since late morning, and DeadLands has been silent since the small hours. Casualty rates are climbing sharply on the principal fronts, enlistment is accelerating, and the war remains undecided with thirty-four victory towns required.
